subject: Request: One-off invoice cadence waiver and short pilot credit terms
messages:
From: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@starkbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Billing Team <billing@starkbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Billing ask for strategic pilot - quarterly cadence + extended terms

Marissa / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team at StarkBridge is keen to run a 3-month pilot starting July 1. A couple of commercial asks on our side before we sign:

- For procurement reasons we need an invoice cadence that is quarterly (one invoice per quarter) during the pilot rather than monthly.
- We also need Net-90 payment terms on the pilot invoice due to internal approval cycles.
- There may be a small strategic credit request (one-time) to offset onboarding costs — approx $10k.

The pilot ARR is relatively modest (~$120k ARR annualized), but this is a strategic integration for us and could expand quickly. I attached a short SOW for context. Can Redwood accommodate a temporary invoice cadence waiver and the Net-90 request for the pilot? If needed we can provide an executive note from our CFO.

Appreciate a quick read — timelines are tight.

Thanks,
Ethan
Head of Platform Partnerships
StarkBridge

Attachments: StarkBridge_SOW.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@starkbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing ask for strategic pilot - quarterly cadence + extended terms

Ethan — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW.

Quick answers up front: we can explore a temporary quarterly invoice cadence for the 3-month pilot and Net-90 on the pilot invoice, but this requires a short internal approval (finance + deal desk + exec signoff) because it changes standard risk exposure and billing cadence. I’ve looped Rishi from Deal Desk.

Couple of details that will affect approval:
- Total exposure during the pilot (estimated invoice amount): ~$30k per quarter (annualized ~120k).
- Do you have a preference on deposit/guarantee? A partial prepayment would make approval much easier.
- Confirm whether the one-time credit request is refundable or applied against the first invoice.

I attached a one-page proposal summary I’ll use for internal approval. Rishi — can you review and advise recommended guardrails (deposit amount, credit cap, other conditions) and whether this qualifies for an exec exception?

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: proposal_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Billing ask for strategic pilot - quarterly cadence + extended terms

Kimberly / Jonas — forwarding a commercial ask from StarkBridge (see thread). Summary: 3-month strategic pilot, requested temporary quarterly invoicing during pilot and Net-90 on pilot invoice; one-time $10k credit request.

Deal facts / risk quick take:
- Pilot invoice run-rate: approx $30k per quarter (invoice = ~$30k).
- Credit exposure if Net-90 accepted with no prepay: ~30k outstanding at any time.
- StarkBridge is a strategic partner (potential platform integration) — good upside.

Recommend one of the following guardrails to approve quickly:
1) Approach A (preferred): 50% prepayment for first quarter, quarterly invoicing thereafter, Net-90 allowed on subsequent pilot invoice(s) but prepayment reduces initial exposure; one-time credit capped at $10k and applied as a service credit on first invoice.
2) Approach B (finance-led): Zero prepay but ACH authorization + signed addendum guaranteeing payment; credit requires exec signoff and max cap $5k.

If finance signs off on Approach A I will document terms in an invoice addendum and ops can issue quarterly invoices. Approving Net-90 on the pilot invoice without prepayment increases our receivable days and risk; I’d like explicit approval for that.

Attached: deal_breakdown.xlsx (xls) with exposure numbers.

Can you confirm direction and whether an exec-level waiver is required? We’ll need an exception logged in Deal Desk and an addendum sent to the customer.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: deal_breakdown.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Billing ask for strategic pilot - quarterly cadence + extended terms

Rishi / Marissa — after reviewing the exposure and strategic rationale I approve a limited exception with the following mandatory conditions: 

1) Duration: Temporary exception for the 3-month pilot only. Quarterly invoicing allowed for the pilot period; after pilot we revert to standard monthly cadence unless Finance signs a further extension.
2) Payment guardrail: 50% prepayment for the first quarter (to be collected before service start). If StarkBridge declines prepayment, we will accept Net-90 only with ACH authorization and a signed payment guarantee from their CFO; in that case we will limit one-time credit to $5,000.
3) Credit: One-time onboarding credit approved up to $10,000 only if 50% prepayment is provided; otherwise cap credit to $5,000 with CFO guarantee.
4) Documentation: Sales to send the invoice addendum (I’ve attached a draft) and obtain signature from StarkBridge prior to kickoff. Deal Desk to file the exception in the Exceptions log and mark as "pilot-exception-2026-06".

Jonas — flagging for awareness as this is a strategic platform partner; no further exec approval required unless StarkBridge requests >$10k credit or extends Net-90 beyond the pilot.

Marissa — please confirm with Ethan which option they accept (prepay + $10k credit or ACH guarantee + $5k credit) and route signed addendum to billing@redwood.com and billing@starkbridge.com. Once we have prepayment or signed guarantee we’ll finalize.

Kimberly Park
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: invoice_addendum_draft.pdf (pdf)
